paper.title: Applications of fMRI for Brain Mapping

result.summary: 本文是一篇综述，介绍脑图谱（brain mapping）技术及其在脑功能研究中的作用，指出仅靠结构成像不足以应对许多神经疾病，需要研究脑的功能组织 [abstract]。作者概述了多种脑图谱技术以及 fMRI 信号处理方法 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的问题是：许多神经疾病仅靠结构研究并不充分，因此需要研究脑的功能组织，并需要在正常与疾病状态下研究脑功能 [abstract]。作者指出，脑图谱技术有助于获取这些方面的重要信息，例如可研究与运动、感觉、言语和记忆等特定活动相关的脑功能及负责的脑区 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: However there are many neurological disorders for which only structure studies are not sufficient.
In such cases it is required to investigate the functional organization of the brain.
Further it is necessary to study the brain functions under normal as well as diseased conditions.
Brain functions and brain area responsible for the particular activities like motor, sensory speech and memory process could be investigated.

method.text: 本文采用综述的方式，概述多种脑图谱技术以及 fMRI 信号处理方法 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The authors provide an overview of various Brain Mapping techniques and fMRI signal processing methods.

findings.text: 作者指出，脑图谱技术已被证明对理解脑的分子、细胞和功能机制至关重要 [abstract]。正常解剖成像能够提供脑内某些异常的结构信息 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Brain-mapping techniques have proven to be vital in understanding the molecular, cellular, and functional mechanisms of the brain.
Normal anatomical imaging can provide structural information on certain abnormalities in the brain.
